info.author: stefmat10
info.name: RadioComSync
info.shortdescription: Overlay radio commentary on TV video
info.description: RadioComSync overlays live radio commentary on TV video for sports. Mutes the DVB audio decoder and plays radio through GStreamer/ALSA. Supports BBC, talkSPORT, RTE, and WLR FM with online and satellite sources. Useful for watching sport on a foreign-language feed with English commentary.
